Specification: This specification models a very small state machine over a single variable x. The system starts with x = 0 and repeatedly executes Next, which increments x while x < 3 and thereafter stutters by leaving x unchanged once x >= 3. The temporal specification requires that Init holds initially and that every step satisfies [][Next]_<<x>>, so all behavior is either a Next step or a stuttering step on x. There is no explicit fault model, no fairness condition, and no proof content.
